experiment.masking: Original global RGB mean, rounded to uint8; no expansion
experiment.deletion: Validated Experiment 1 Telea radius 3; strictly positive SHAP descending, ascending-index tie break
experiment.tail: Constant preference to x=1 solely for integration; not an actual deletion state
experiment.unreached_threshold: Missing; report coverage and common-case paired rates
experiment.all_masked_fallback: Validated global RGB mean for Telea with no remaining context
experiment.runtime: Shared inference separately from each regression
experiment.matched_evaluation: All signed SHAP descending with ascending index ties; whole-region first crossing of 10/20/30/40/50 percent; normalized trapezoid to actual 50 crossing; no extrapolation
experiment.dataset: Separate SugarCrepe and Flickr30k B/16 replication arms
experiment.selection: 200 unique images per arm; uniform image permutation, one eligible instance per image, fixed reserves before outcomes
experiment.captions: SugarCrepe dataset-defined pairs; Flickr30k B/16 highest GT and strongest other-image caption in full5000 pool
